question: How much will Nvidia's stock price returns exceed Microsoft's in these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Quantity is a 2-week relative return over ~10 trading days (Sep 21-Oct 2), with no earnings for either name in the window (MSFT Oct 28, NVDA ~mid-Nov) and no NVDA conference (GTC Berlin Oct 20-22, GTC DC Nov 30-Dec 3). Reference class: 10-trading-day NVDA-MSFT spreads. Center is near zero: the 2y mean is about +1.3pp per 10 trading days and the 1y mean about +0.9pp (NVDA's long-run alpha), but the last 3 months ran -0.4pp as MSFT re-rated ~+26% post-earnings while NVDA went sideways. I keep a token +0.2pp median - NVDA's beta gap (2.22 vs 1.11) times ~0.4% two-week market drift argues +0.4pp, offset by an actively negative NVDA news tape (Amodei/Musk/Altman slowdown calls Sep 12-14, custom-silicon competition, memory-cost margin compression to 71-73%). Dispersion dominates the answer: realized daily correlation between the two has collapsed to ~0 over 3 months - Fortune calls it the 'AI doomsday trade', chipmakers down while hyperscalers gain - so the pair no longer hedges itself. Earnings-free 10-day windows realized SD 5.1pp; IV-implied ~6.5pp; I use ~5.8pp. Left tail is fatter (NVDA is the higher-beta leg and the one carrying the AI-capex narrative risk), hence slightly larger escape mass below. No market prices this pair: Manifold's candidate is Big Tech vs Bitcoin through 2030, Polymarket has only largest-company (NVDA 61%) and earnings-beat contracts, Kalshi has Nasdaq-100 ranges and unapproved NVDA perps - none match threshold, horizon or resolution source, so no blend. Note: no Python or shell available this run; vol/correlation/quantile stats were computed by hand from the fetched close series, so treat the third digit as noise.
